children: Cascadia Minerals Ltd. (V.CAM) Hit a new 52-Week High of 51 cents. Cascadia announced the appointment of Stuart Van Bibber as Vice President Sustainability and Regulatory Affairs. In this role he will oversee all aspects of community engagement and consultation, government and regulatory affairs, environmental and land management.
Cabral Gold Inc. (V.CBR) Hit a new 52-Week High of $1.55. Cabral announced the first gold pour at Cabral's 100% owned Phase 1 Cuiú Cuiú mine in Brazil.
Canadian Natural Resources Limited (T.CNQ) Hit a new 52-Week High of $70.58. No news stories available.

Cenovus Energy Inc. (T.CVE) Hit a new 52-Week High of $46.12. On Tuesday, the stock's performance was ahead of the S&P 500's daily loss of 0.58%. Meanwhile, the Dow experienced a drop of 1.18%, and the technology-dominated NASDAQ saw a decrease of 0.32%.
Glacier Media Inc (T.GVC) Hit a new 52-Week High of 38 cents. No news stories available today.

Logan Energy Corp. (V.LGN) Hit a new 52-Week High of $1.19. Last month, Logan reported adjusted Funds Flow increased to $47.8 million ($0.07 per share, diluted) for the three months ended June 30, 2026, an increase of 76% from $27.2 million ($0.04 per share, diluted) reported in the comparative three-month period of 2025.
RESAAS Services Inc. (V.RSS) Hit a new 52-Week High of 55 cents. RESAAS announced that it has been invited to present at the Annual Smallcap Discoveries Conference in Vancouver on September 29.
Pharmala Biotech Holdings Inc (C.MDMA) Hit a new 52-Week High of 29.5 cents. PharmAla announced three corporate updates.

Mineros SA (T.MSA) Hit a new 52-Week High of $8.98. In July, Mineros adopted a formal Strategic Gold Reserve Policy under its Investment Management Policy. The Policy establishes physical gold bullion as a core treasury asset of the Company.

Surge Energy Inc. (T.SGY) Hit a new 52-Week High of $12.18. Surge confirms that a cash dividend to be paid on September 15, in respect of August production, for the shareholders of record on August 31 will be $0.043333 per share.
Suncor Energy Inc. (T.SU) Hit a new 52-Week High of $94.98. No news stories available today.

Talon Metals Corp. (T.TLO) Hit a new 52-Week High of $10.59. Talon Metals announced assay results from the previously reported record 46.43-meter interval of Massive Sulphide Unit and Mixed Massive Sulphide Unit mineralization in drill hole 25TK0562A at the Tamarack Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project, located in central Minnesota.
Total Energy Services Inc (T.TOT) Hit a new 52-Week High of $34.80. No news stories available today.

Whitecap Resources Inc. (T.WCP) Hit a new 52-Week High of $18.74. In July, ARC Resources reported net income of $353 million during the second quarter, compared with net income of $396.1 million a year earlier.

title: Cascadia, Cabral, Cenovus at 52-Week Highs on News
